items.title: Phishing in the Balkans: Fake Traffic Fines, Real Losses
items.content: An active SMS phishing campaign targets Serbian road users by impersonating Putevi Srbije, Serbia's state road authority. Victims receive text messages claiming they have unpaid traffic fines with urgent payment demands. The fraudulent links lead to cloned government websites designed to steal payment card details. items.title: Indirect Prompt Injection in Web Content Targets AI Agents
items.content: AI agents are increasingly vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, where malicious instructions are embedded in web content to manipulate AI-driven workflows. items.title: Armored Likho's new weapon: BusySnake Stealer
items.content: Kaspersky uncovered a sophisticated phishing campaign by the APT group Armored Likho, deploying a previously undocumented Python-based infostealer dubbed BusySnake Stealer.
